meta.title: Wiring Test - Qwen3-32B
meta.author: tt-inference-server maintainers
meta.notes:
Synthetic validation plan, not a customer requirement. It exists to exercise the --requirements-json path end to end against a model that is easy to bring up: one text scenario, one agentic workload, four accuracy evals. Every target in it is an arbitrary placeholder and says nothing about Qwen3-32B or any other model, so a pass or fail here means only that the plumbing ran.

Two operating points will not execute as written, deliberately, so the reporting path for them stays covered: the four ISL-131072 rows equal the whole context window and leave no room for output, and the agentic sweep's concurrency 64 exceeds the declared 32.
